text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Tokyo Daishoten, and Oi Racecourse is packed with an unbelievable number of spectators.
Inspired by Smart Falcon's passion, her fans have taken it upon themselves to spread the word, bringing a record number of people to the venue for her greatest stage yet.
Nothing could possibly make Smart Falcon happier than she is right now—except perhaps for one last thing…
If she can shine upon this greatest of stages, that will surely be the greatest happiness of all. In order to become a top Umadol, Smart Falcon heads to the final performance of her tour.
